fact: The Botswana Press Agency reports that UniPod Botswana at the University of Botswana incubates business ideas, has ten specialised laboratories and has six start-ups at commercial acceleration (TRL 6-9).
The Botswana Innovation Hub is to provide Botswana Tech Fund portfolio companies with physical infrastructure, deal pipelines and ecosystem integration, per Disrupt Africa.
We Are Tech Africa reports the Botswana Innovation Fund and Scalar International launched a 12-month accelerator supporting ten climate and digital startups.
TechCabal reports the Botswana Innovation Fund and Scalar International launched on 10 March 2026 in Gaborone a 12-month programme supporting 10 climate and digital startups.

The Deputy Permanent Secretary thanked the Botswana Digital and Innovation Hub for supporting businesses through its innovation programme, acceleration programme, commercialisation and funding, and its board member described its incubation of IoT Communications.

The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub says it convened a workshop of academia, research and private-sector stakeholders around 9 December 2025 on an open data hackathon; no incubation programme or cohort is stated.

Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub is open and runs the Open Data Innovation Challenge programme, with three ventures from Phase 1 reported in pre-incubation; no incubation cohort programme is described.
Botswana Tech Fund announced seven startups, three from Botswana, for its first three-month accelerator cohort, with sessions to be held in Gaborone and a demo day, per BW TechZone.
BDIH, with MIT's Kuo Sharper Innovation Centre, launched an accelerator programme for 31 local SMMEs that began with a three-day bootcamp at BDIH headquarters (Mmegi).

Acting CEO Diane Mongudi says the Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub has run an incubation programme, begun in 2011 as the First Step Venture Centre, taking startups from ideation to market entry, with graduates now needing commercialisation help.
